infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Studio Log uses the camera to capture process photos, test tiles, kiln loads, and finished pieces.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Studio Log imports photos from your library for recipes, projects, firings, inspiration, and gallery pieces.
